## 0. Setup

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  sf,
  janitor,
  ggplot2,
  ggthemes,
  viridis,
  rnaturalearth, 
  nhdplusTools,
  knitr
)

dir_merit <- "/Users/regi350/offline_work/GitHub/RC/metabolism_allometry/data/processed/merit_data"

path_cat <- file.path(dir_merit, "002_cat_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_riv <- file.path(dir_merit, "002_riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_upstream_lookup <- file.path(dir_merit, "003_upstream_lookup.rds")
path_drainage_missing <- file.path(dir_merit, "003_upstream_drainage_missing.rds")
```

## 1. Read routing inputs

```{r}
merit_cat_v2 <- read_sf(path_cat) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

merit_riv_v2 <- read_sf(path_riv) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    nxt_dw = as.character(nxt_dw)
  )

upstream_lookup <- base::readRDS(path_upstream_lookup)
```

## 2. Calculate missing upstream drainage area

```{r}
catchment_area <- merit_cat_v2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(comid, unitarea)

retained_upstream_area <- upstream_lookup %>%
  left_join(
    catchment_area %>%
      rename(upstream_comid = comid,
             upstream_unitarea = unitarea),
    by = "upstream_comid"
  ) %>%
  group_by(downstream_comid) %>%
  summarise(
    retained_upstream_area_km2 = sum(upstream_unitarea, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_upstream_reaches = n_distinct(upstream_comid),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

drainage_missing <- merit_riv_v2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(comid, huc, uparea) %>%
  rename(downstream_comid = comid) %>%
  left_join(retained_upstream_area, by = "downstream_comid") %>%
  mutate(
    retained_upstream_area_km2 = replace_na(retained_upstream_area_km2, 0),
    area_ratio_retained = retained_upstream_area_km2 / uparea,
    pct_area_missing = pmax(0, 1 - area_ratio_retained) * 100,
    missing_area_class = case_when(
      pct_area_missing < 1 ~ "<1%",
      pct_area_missing < 5 ~ "1-5%",
      pct_area_missing < 10 ~ "5-10%",
      pct_area_missing >= 10 ~ ">=10%",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    missing_area_class = factor(
      missing_area_class,
      levels = c("<1%", "1-5%", "5-10%", ">=10%")
    )
  )

base::saveRDS(drainage_missing, path_drainage_missing)
```

## 3. Summary table

```{r}
drainage_missing %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n(),
    median_pct_area_missing = median(pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_pct_area_missing = quantile(pct_area_missing, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95_pct_area_missing = quantile(pct_area_missing, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    p99_pct_area_missing = quantile(pct_area_missing, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ge_1pct = sum(pct_area_missing >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ge_5pct = sum(pct_area_missing >= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ge_10pct = sum(pct_area_missing >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
drainage_missing %>%
  count(missing_area_class, name = "n_reaches") %>%
  mutate(pct_reaches = n_reaches / sum(n_reaches) * 100) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

## 4. Plot missing drainage area

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(drainage_missing, aes(x = pct_area_missing)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1, 5, 10), linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50)) +
  labs(
    x = "Upstream drainage area missing (%)",
    y = "Number of focal reaches"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(drainage_missing, aes(x = missing_area_class)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Missing upstream drainage area class",
    y = "Number of focal reaches"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 5. Map missing drainage area

```{r}
drainage_missing_map <- merit_riv_v2 %>%
  left_join(
    drainage_missing %>%
      select(downstream_comid, pct_area_missing, missing_area_class),
    by = c("comid" = "downstream_comid")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = drainage_missing_map,
    aes(color = pct_area_missing),
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    trans = "sqrt",
    limits = c(0, 50),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "% missing"
  ) +
  labs(color = "Missing upstream drainage area (%)") +
  theme_map() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = drainage_missing_map %>%
      filter(pct_area_missing >= 10),
    aes(color = pct_area_missing),
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "% missing"
  ) +
  labs(color = "Missing upstream drainage area (%)") +
  theme_map() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## 6. HUC8-level summary map

```{r}
# 6. HUC8-level summary map ----------------------------------------------------

huc_missing_summary <- drainage_missing %>%
  group_by(huc) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n(),
    median_pct_area_missing = median(pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pct_area_missing = max(pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_reaches_ge_10pct_missing = mean(pct_area_missing >= 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conus <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "United States of America",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!postal %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

huc08_conus <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = conus,
  type = "huc08"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  rename(huc = huc8) %>%
  mutate(huc = as.character(huc)) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs)

huc_map <- huc08_conus %>%
  semi_join(huc_missing_summary, by = "huc") %>%
  left_join(huc_missing_summary, by = "huc")
```


```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = huc_map,
    aes(fill = max_pct_area_missing),
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "% reaches >=10%\nmissing area",
    na.value = "gray90"
  ) +
  theme_map() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## 7. Cumulative upstream area check

This check compares cumulative upstream catchment area reconstructed from the routing network against MERIT `uparea`. Values near 1 indicate that retained upstream catchments reproduce MERIT drainage area for a focal reach.

```{r}
cumulative_area_check <- drainage_missing %>%
  mutate(
    area_ratio_retained = retained_upstream_area_km2 / uparea,
    log10_uparea = log10(uparea),
    log10_retained_upstream_area = log10(retained_upstream_area_km2),
    area_ratio_class = case_when(
      area_ratio_retained < 0.90 ~ "<0.90",
      area_ratio_retained <= 1.10 ~ "0.90-1.10",
      area_ratio_retained > 1.10 ~ ">1.10",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    area_ratio_class = factor(area_ratio_class, levels = c("<0.90", "0.90-1.10", ">1.10"))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
  pct_area_missing = pmax(0, 1 - retained_upstream_area_km2 / uparea) * 100,
  drainage_area_quality = case_when(
    pct_area_missing < 2 ~ "1. complete",
    pct_area_missing < 10 ~ "2. minor_missing",
    pct_area_missing < 20 ~ "3. moderate_missing",
    TRUE ~ "4. major_missing"
  )
)

cumulative_area_check %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n(),
    median_area_ratio = median(area_ratio_retained, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_area_ratio = quantile(area_ratio_retained, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95_area_ratio = quantile(area_ratio_retained, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lt_090 = sum(area_ratio_retained < 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gt_110 = sum(area_ratio_retained > 1.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_outside_10pct = mean(area_ratio_retained < 0.90 | area_ratio_retained > 1.10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```



```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
ggplot(cumulative_area_check, aes(x = uparea, y = retained_upstream_area_km2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1, aes(color = drainage_area_quality), show.legend = F) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~drainage_area_quality) + 
  labs(
    x = "MERIT upstream drainage area, uparea (km²)",
    y = "Retained cumulative upstream catchment area (km²)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = cumulative_area_map,
    aes(color = area_ratio_retained),
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    trans = "sqrt",
    limits = c(0, 1.2),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Retained area /\nMERIT uparea"
  ) +
  theme_map() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = cumulative_area_map,
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = cumulative_area_map %>%
      filter(uparea >= 1000),
    aes(color = uparea, linewidth = uparea),
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "A",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "MERIT upstream\ndrainage area (km²)"
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    range = c(0, 0.8),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_map() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
